text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with chestnut hair swept into an elegant high updo, light wispy bangs, warm amber eyes, pale peach skin and soft coral lips. Small gold floral forehead ornament, gold floral hairpins and fine chain earrings. Pale blue silk outer robe with delicate golden patterns over a peach and ivory bodice, soft peach draping. Complete floor-length pale peach softly pleated flowing silk SKIRT and fitted peach ivory bodice, pale blue floral gold-embroidered long open robe with broad sleeves, peach ribbon sash, ivory embroidered flat shoe tips visible. No pants. Tall slender 174 cm. One independent full-body portrait, strict front view, head upright, level eye line, relaxed standing arms by sides hands out of pockets, entire hair to soles included with generous margin. Elegant 7.8-head tall long-limbed model proportions, anatomically coherent. Vertical 2:3. Tall elegant female fashion-model anatomy with approximately 7.8 anatomical head lengths from skull crown to bare-foot soles. Head including skull but excluding hair volume is about 12.8% of total standing body height, visibly smaller relative to the body than a 6–7-head figure. Long naturally proportioned legs and arms, normal-length neck, natural shoulder width and pelvis. Do not elongate her face or neck or merely enlarge shoes. Straight camera with no foreshortening. Include every hair ornament to shoe tips; white space on all edges.
